name: jev-classifier
audience_feeling: A researcher should understand the useful path and its limits before learning internal module names.
promise: Turn one supplied research fragment into a structured JEV judgment record with a traceable evidence pointer.

preferred_terms.paper draft: six-section structural draft with an optional deterministic Synthesis section

good_examples: One fragment goes to a closed JEV label set; malformed answers fail closed.
The two-source demo uses synthetic fixture text and mocked responses.
bad_examples: The system proves whether a research agent is biased.
Grok output is automatically trusted and turned into a paper.
